name: WP Video Playlist
author: Sandeep Kumar(Sean)

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin .zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the .zip file and install the plugin.
  5. Activate the WP Video Playlist plugin from the plugin list.
  6. Go to Video Player, add your videos, and enjoy!
sections.faq:
How do I add videos to the playlist?

  1. Navigate to Video Player from the WordPress sidebar.
  2. Click Add Video beside the Videos section.
  3. Click the Add Video button and select the video you want to add.
  4. Optionally, add a custom title and URL:
    • The first field is for the video title.
    • The second field is for the video URL.
  5. Click Save to finalize your playlist.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode and paste it wherever you want to display the video player.

How do I add the video player in Elementor?

  1. Open the page where you want to add the Video Player.
  2. Locate the FDK category in the Elementor sidebar.
  3. Drag and drop the Video Player widget into your desired location on the page.

How do I add the video player in Gutenberg?

  1. Open the page or post where you want to add the WP Video Playlist block.
  2. Click the Add Block button (the + icon).
  3. Search for WP Video Playlist in the block search bar.
  4. Click on the WP Video Playlist block to add it to your content.
  5. Configure the block settings as needed.
  6. Publish or update the page to display the video playlist.

sections.description:
Easily create and display video playlists on your WordPress site using media files or YouTube videos.

Features

  • Add video items to a playlist directly from your media files.
  • Include YouTube videos in your playlist.

Shortcodes

Use the following shortcode to display the video playlist anywhere on your site:

[videoplayer]
